# Germany Tankerkönig fixture

Synthetic fixture mirroring the current Tankerkönig `list.php` station JSON shape (verified 2026-08-17 against https://creativecommons.tankerkoenig.de).

Includes:

- Berlin and Potsdam stations with E5/E10/Diesel
- unavailable E10 (`false`)
- closed station (`isOpen: false`)
- station without brand
- station with all prices unavailable
- malformed UUID row

No API key included.
